basics.name: Guido Ivetta
basics.summary: Currently employed at Universidad Nacional de Córdoba / Fundación Vía Libre. PhD Student in Computer Science at Universidad Nacional de Córdoba (Argentina).

highlights: Teaching undergraduate and graduate Computer Science courses (Natural Language Processing, Text Mining, Algorithms)
Designing practical assignments, supervising lab coursework, and mentoring students
Researching algorithmic fairness, social bias detection, and regional stereotyping in LLMs
Co-designing community benchmarks and contributing to public policy reports in Latin America
Research collaboration on participatory AI and health conversational agents supervised by Prof. Rafael A. Calvo
Serving on the Ethics Committee of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL)
Co-instructing ethics tutorials and reviewing ethical considerations in NLP research

publications.name: A Methodology to Characterize Bias and Harmful Stereotypes in Natural Language Processing in Latin America
publications.summary: Presents a pioneering methodology to characterize harmful stereotypes and demographic biases across Spanish language technologies in Latin America.

publications.name: Aprendizaje Automático Aplicado a la Huerta Familiar Agroecológica en la Patagonia
publications.publisher: Tesina de Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación, FaMAF, Universidad Nacional de Córdoba
publications.summary: Tesina de Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación sobre técnicas de machine learning aplicadas al manejo agroecológico de huertas familiares.

publications.name: Your Stereotypical Mileage May Vary: Practical Challenges of Evaluating Biases in Multiple Languages and Cultural Contexts
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 2024 Joint International Conference on Computational Linguistics, Language Resources and Evaluation (LREC-COLING 2024)
publications.summary: Examines practical challenges of evaluating social biases in NLP across multiple languages and socio-cultural settings, illustrating how regional stereotypes cannot simply be translated from English benchmarks.

publications.name: CVQA: Culturally-diverse Multilingual Visual Question Answering Benchmark
publications.publisher: Thirty-eighth Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2024)
publications.summary: Visual Question Answering (VQA) is a crucial task in multimodal AI, often used to test vision-language models on understanding visual and linguistic information. CVQA introduces a culturally-diverse multilingual benchmark covering 30+ languages to evaluate model generalization across diverse cultural contexts.

publications.name: Detecting Correct Answers to Open Questions and Its Impact on Language Models' Confidence Scores
publications.publisher: LatinX in AI (LXAI) Research Workshop at NAACL 2024, Mexico City
publications.summary: Explores how the automatic detection of correct open-ended answers influences model confidence scoring and calibration in Large Language Models.

publications.name: Exploring Stereotypes and Biases in Language Technologies in Latin America
publications.summary: Discusses the impacts of automated language technologies in Latin America and highlights participatory methodologies to uncover and mitigate local biases.

publications.name: Selectively Answering Visual Questions
publications.publisher: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2024
publications.summary: Investigates selective prediction in multimodal models, enabling large vision-language models to abstain from answering questions when their confidence is low.

publications.name: Sesgos en Modelos de Lenguaje y Construcción Participativa de Benchmarks de Evaluación
publications.publisher: Trabajo Final de Grado, FaMAF, Universidad Nacional de Córdoba
publications.summary: Investigación sobre evaluación de sesgos en modelos de lenguaje y metodologías de diseño participativo de benchmarks.

publications.name: SHADES: Towards a Multilingual Assessment of Stereotypes in Large Language Models
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference of the North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Human Language Technologies (NAACL 2025)
publications.summary: A global multi-stakeholder benchmark evaluating stereotypical associations and harms in language models across dozens of languages and cultural communities.

publications.name: CaMMT: Benchmarking Culturally Aware Multimodal Machine Translation
publications.publisher: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025
publications.summary: Introduces CaMMT, an evaluation benchmark for culturally aware multimodal machine translation spanning diverse cultural concepts, images, and languages.

publications.name: ROSA: Addressing Text Understanding Challenges in Photographs via ROtated SAmpling
publications.summary: Introduces ROtated SAmpling (ROSA) to significantly improve vision-language model robustness when reading rotated or misoriented text in photographs taken by visually impaired users.

publications.name: La Leaderboard: A Large Language Model Leaderboard for Spanish Varieties and Languages of Spain and Latin America
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2025)
publications.summary: An open evaluation benchmark and leaderboard tracking language model performance across regional varieties of Spanish and co-official languages of Spain and Latin America.

publications.name: Navigating Ethical Challenges in NLP: Hands-on Strategies for Students and Researchers
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2025 Tutorial Abstracts)
publications.summary: A tutorial presented at ACL 2025 providing hands-on strategies and ethical frameworks for NLP practitioners, students, and reviewers.

publications.name: Synthetic Social Data: Trials and Tribulations
publications.summary: Critically examines the opportunities and ethical pitfalls of using Large Language Models to generate synthetic conversational data for social and behavioral science.

publications.name: HESEIA: A Community-Based Dataset for Evaluating Social Biases in Large Language Models, Co-Designed in Real School Settings in Latin America
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2025)
publications.summary: Presents HESEIA, a benchmark for evaluating social biases in LLMs created through participatory co-design workshops with secondary school students in Latin America.

publications.name: Insights from a Disaggregated Analysis of Kinds of Biases in a Multicultural Dataset
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 9th Widening NLP Workshop (WiNLP 2025)
publications.summary: Presents a fine-grained disaggregated evaluation of specific stereotypes and biases within multicultural datasets, revealing disparate impacts across demographic axes.

publications.name: Logical Reasoning Evaluation and Social Bias
publications.publisher: ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models
publications.summary: Reviews how stereotypes and socio-cultural priors interact with reasoning chains and formal deduction in Large Language Models.

publications.name: Adaptive Data Collection for Latin-American Community-sourced Evaluation of Stereotypes (LACES)
publications.publisher: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
publications.summary: Proposes LACES, an adaptive community-sourced protocol for collecting and evaluating regional stereotypes in Latin America.

publications.name: Towards Culturally-Appropriate AI for Health in the Majority World: Insights from Participatory Work in Latin America
publications.summary: Investigates requirements and ethical considerations for conversational health AI in Latin America through participatory research with citizens and clinicians.

presentations.name: Detecting Correct Answers to Open Questions and Its Impact on Language Models' Confidence Scores
presentations.event: LatinX in AI (LXAI) Research Workshop at NAACL 2024
presentations.description: Presentation on calibration, uncertainty estimation, and evaluation of open question answering in LLMs.

presentations.name: Socio-Cultural Evaluation of AI
presentations.event: Khipu: Latin American Meeting in Artificial Intelligence
presentations.description: Hands-on tutorial and practical session on socio-cultural evaluation of stereotypes and biases in language models.

presentations.name: Navigating Ethical Challenges in NLP: Hands-on Strategies for Students and Researchers
presentations.event: 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2025)
presentations.description: Tutorial at ACL 2025 covering ethical issues in NLP, hands-on strategies for evaluation, and responsible research practices.

presentations.name: Insights from a Disaggregated Analysis of Kinds of Biases in a Multicultural Dataset
presentations.description: Presentation on fine-grained disaggregated evaluation of specific stereotypes in multicultural datasets.

presentations.name: Logical Reasoning Evaluation and Social Bias
presentations.event: ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models
presentations.description: Talk examining the interaction between formal logical reasoning in LLMs and socio-cultural bias traces.
